lessons.title: Paragraph Practice 1
lessons.description: Sustained typing of a short paragraph.

exercises.text: Touch typing is the ability to type without looking at the keyboard. It relies on muscle memory built through consistent practice. The foundation is the home row position where your fingers rest between keystrokes.

When you first start learning to touch type, progress can feel slow. You may make many mistakes and feel tempted to look down at the keys. Resist that urge. Looking at the screen trains your fingers to find the correct keys on their own.

lessons.title: Bonus: Speed Focus
lessons.description: Push your WPM while holding accuracy.

exercises.text: The only way to improve typing speed is through deliberate practice with immediate feedback. Focus on the next character, keep a steady rhythm, and let your fingers learn the patterns.

Accuracy is the foundation of good typing. Every error costs time because you must correct it. Train yourself to type the correct key the first time. Slow down if needed. Clean technique produces lasting speed.
